result.title: Pagination returns every borrower with no gaps between pages
result.description: Regression guard for BUG-1: server/routes.js:53 sliced `start, start + limit - 1` while advancing `start` by `limit`, making one borrower per page window unreachable.
result.preconditions: App running at http://localhost:3000 with default seed data (60 borrowers, page size 10).

steps.expected_result: The table shows 10 rows and the page indicator reads `Page 1 of 6`

steps.action: Note the borrower in the last row of page 1
steps.expected_result: It is the 10th borrower in the default order
The first row is the 11th borrower in the default order - no borrower is skipped between pages
